newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR slips on reserve requirement cut.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR slips on reserve requirement cut.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) slipped across all maturities on Monday amid the one percentage-point cut in reserve requirements, traders said on Monday.
"PHIBOR just followed the overnight rates," a dealer said.
A trader said the declining domestic interest rates on account of the reserve cut had prompted many banks to lower their swap rates for pesos in exchange for dollars.
The reserve cut, which took effect last Friday, added an estimated 6.7 billion pesos in investible funds to banks.
